card.title: How To Fix iPhone X That Does Not Power On

source.title: How To Fix iPhone X That Does Not Power On

claims.statement: iPhone X short before power-on: check PP_VDD_MAIN, PP_VDD_BOOST, PP_SPKRAMP_TOP_VBOOST; inject 4 V / 2 A and remove the shorted cap (sandwich split usually required).
Short after power-on (bouncing current): PP3V0_NAND, PP0V9_NAND, PP1V8_IO; RAM short if PP1V8_S2 / PP1V1_S2 shorted with heat above CPU. Q3350 and U2700 heating during injection are not the fault.

procedure: Find short on VDD_MAIN / VDD_BOOST / SPKRAMP_TOP_VBOOST or NAND/IO rails.
Inject voltage, locate and remove the shorted cap.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Incorrect sandwich splitting can permanently damage the board.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
